info.announcement_text: Leave empty to hide the announcement bar.
info.bundle_builder_collection: Shows the first 9 products. The block is hidden when no collection is selected.
info.bundle_builder_discount_note: Shows only when a tier is above 0%.
info.bundle_builder_link: Add both a label and a link to show it.
info.bundle_builder_tiers: Tiers are display only. Create an automatic discount in Shopify admin with the same quantities and percentages, or customers won't get this price at checkout. A tier at 0% is off.
info.cart_type: Choose what happens after a customer adds a product: open the cart drawer or go to the cart page.
info.free_shipping_threshold: Order total for free shipping, in your store currency. Use 0 to hide the bar. The bar also hides in markets that use another currency.
info.collection_columns_desktop: Applies from 1280px. Tablet shows up to 3 columns.
info.columns_desktop: Applies from 1280px. Mobile shows 2 columns and tablet shows 3.
info.countdown_end: Use the format YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM in your store's time zone, for example 2030-12-31 23:59. The countdown shows only before this time, when the product is in stock and has a compare-at price. Leave empty to hide it.
info.faq_allow_multiple: When off, opening a question closes the one already open.
info.faq_show_item: Empty fields use the sample content. Turn off to hide this question.
info.faq_show_stat: Empty fields use the sample content. Turn off to hide this stat.
info.sample_text: Leave empty to use the sample text.
info.featured_collection_collection: On the home page, all products show when no collection is selected.
info.heading_font: Used for headings. The default font uses weights 700 and 800.
info.image_with_text_accent_image: Small image shown from 1280px, or in a row above the text on the centered banner layout. Leave empty to hide.
info.image_with_text_accent_image_3: Shows on the centered banner layout only. Leave empty to hide.
info.image_with_text_eyebrow: Leave empty to use the sample text. The centered banner layout has no sample eyebrow, so it stays hidden.
info.image_with_text_image: Has no effect on the centered banner layout, which has no main image.
info.image_with_text_image_position: Applies from 1024px; on smaller screens the image is above the text. Has no effect on the centered banner layout.
info.image_with_text_show_item: Empty fields use the sample content. Turn off to hide this block.
info.logo: Shows the shop name when no logo is selected.
info.custom_liquid: Add Liquid or HTML, up to 50 KB. You can use global objects, objects of the current template, and standard tags and filters. You can't use layout, content_for_header, content_for_layout, content_for_index, section, javascript, stylesheet, schema, or settings. Unclosed HTML tags are closed when you save. Leave empty to hide this block.
info.multicolumn_column_heading: Leave the heading, text, image, and link label empty to hide this column.
info.multicolumn_link_label: Leave empty to hide this link.
info.multicolumn_link_url: Goes to all products when empty.
info.sticky_header: Keeps the header at the top of the screen while scrolling.
info.product_recommendations_columns: Applies from 1280px. Mobile shows 2 columns and tablet shows up to 3.
info.product_recommendations_heading: Leave empty to use the default heading: You may also like for related products, Pairs well with for complementary products.
info.muted_light: Use on light backgrounds only. Keep contrast at 4.5:1 or higher.
info.muted_on_dark: Use on the dark background only. Keep contrast at 4.5:1 or higher.
info.background_sand_foreground: Use secondary text, not light secondary text, on the sand background to keep contrast at 4.5:1 or higher.
info.quiz_body_map: Decorative image next to the options. Hidden on mobile. Leave empty to give the options the full width.
info.quiz_collection: Results and the link shown when nothing matches come from this collection. Uses all products when empty.
info.quiz_empty_text: Shown when no product matches all the answers.
info.quiz_note: Short text next to an icon. Leave empty to hide.
info.quiz_option: An option shows when it has both a label and a product tag. A step needs at least 2 options to show.
info.rich_text_button_url: Goes to all products when empty.
info.rich_text_heading_after_image: Continues the heading after the inline image.
info.rich_text_inline_image: Decorative image shown inside the heading, before the heading after image. Leave empty to hide.
info.rich_text_heading_level: Each page should have one Heading 1. The first slide of the slideshow already uses it on the home page.
info.show_dynamic_checkout: Lets customers check out directly with a payment method they already use, such as Shop Pay.
info.show_wordmark: Shows the store name in large text.
info.slide_button_label: Leave empty to hide this button.
info.slide_show_item: Empty fields use the sample content. Turn off to hide this slide.
info.slide_content_alignment: Applies to tablet and desktop. Content is always centered on mobile.
info.slide_video: Plays muted on a loop and replaces the image. The video preview image shows while it loads.
info.space_base: All spacing in the theme is a multiple of this value.
info.spec_label: The value comes from the product metafields custom.spec_1 to custom.spec_4. A row with no label or no value stays hidden.
info.testimonial_product: Optional. Choose the product this customer reviewed.
info.testimonial_rating: Enter a whole number from 0 to 5. Leave empty to use the sample rating.
info.testimonial_show_item: Empty fields use the sample content. Turn off to hide this review.
info.testimonial_verified: Turn on only when you have verified this purchase.
info.trust_text: Leave empty to hide this item.
